part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `GeoEncodingUtils.java` — both `DistancePredicate.test` (lucene/core/src/java/org/apache/lucene/geo/GeoEncodingUtils.java:366) and `Component2DPredicate.test` (:414) used `lat2 >= latBase + maxLatDelta` as an upper bounds check. For polygons near latitude 90, `latBase + maxLatDelta` (e.g. `2147483646 + 2`) overflows `int` and wraps to `Integer.MIN_VALUE`, so every point failed the check and the fast component predicate rejected all matches — visible only on the doc-values path (the indexed path short-circuits via cell-level `CELL_INSIDE_QUERY` relation).

The fix compares without overflow: `lat2 - latBase >= maxLatDelta` (safe since `lat2 >= latBase` is checked first and both are non-negative shifted values).
